architecture: Five separately fitted two-layer relation-aware GNNs; fixed mean of member cosine similarities

evaluation.scope: whole-program paired-task retrieval, not statement localization or formal equivalence

limitations: 143 small HumanEval-derived source pairs, not banking migrations.
Pair labels express upstream correspondence, not formal equivalence or defect locations.
Heuristic operation graphs are not full compiler ASTs or control-flow graphs.
Names are excluded from the model; the name-matching baseline can outperform it.
Cosine similarities are not calibrated correctness probabilities.
Final holdout is excluded from this fit and CV, but all 23 tasks were previously evaluated by v1; it is not pristine unseen or external data.
Financial-domain generalization, repair, and defect prediction remain unvalidated.
The selected-epoch out-of-fold results were used for epoch selection; they are exploratory selection evidence, not an unbiased nested-CV generalization estimate.
CV galleries contain 24 candidates; final evaluation contains 23. Metrics from different gallery sizes or earlier 29-task reports are not directly comparable.
All final 23 tasks were previously evaluated in v1 and v2. The no-refit protocol was requested after those results were visible; this final comparison is descriptive, not a new unbiased validation.
A fixed equal-mean cosine ensemble retains all five CV checkpoints. No individual fold, ensemble weight, aggregation rule, seed or epoch is selected using final-holdout results.
Each retained member fits 96 development pairs. Across the five members all 120 development pairs are used, but no member is fitted or refitted on all 120.
Pooled out-of-fold metrics describe one held-out member per development query; they do not estimate the deployed five-member ensemble, whose other members saw that development query.
These experiments do not isolate or prove that the v2 full-development refit caused a change in generalization or weight variance.

dataset.underlyingTasks: HumanEval (MIT); upstream benchmark translations are not independently audited
dataset.use: paired-source contrastive correspondence training and task-grouped evaluation; not equivalence labels

finalHoldoutPriorExposure.limitation: The same final 23 were evaluated in both v1 and v2. They remain excluded from every new fit and CV choice, but are previously exposed evaluation tasks, not new unforeseen data. The user-requested no-refit comparison is descriptive.

provenance.generatedBy: AI-assisted implementation; actual CPU fitting on pinned paired source

calibration.method: Fixed before CV and final evaluation; no holdout threshold selection.
calibration.reason: Benchmark-only retrieval evidence; financial-domain reliability remains unvalidated. Every ranking requires explicit human review.

training.dataset: COBOL-JavaTrans (143 original source pairs; 120 development / 23 final fitting holdout)
featureLeakageControls: whole related-task graph components kept together before fitting
training.objective: symmetric paired-source InfoNCE; temperature0.12; Adam0.004; weight decay0.0001
training.selection: One common epoch selected by pooled 120 out-of-fold reciprocal ranks (MRR), then query-weighted validation loss, then earliest checkpoint. No final-set selection.
